svg.desc: Your goal decides where to start. A quick reply, a future action and a report with sources need different checks. Chat. Shorten one sentence. Read it again to see if it still says the same thing. Tasks. Set up work for later where available. Read the saved timing and requested output. Deep Research. Ask for two public guides on light for indoor beans. Open each guide and check its advice.
